description: Architecture milestone benchmark matrix. Comparison rows are equivalent real builds on both sides. Failing rows are required comparisons that are not implemented yet.

phases.title: Dynamic derivation primitive probes
phases.notes: Runs committed Nix primitive probes, including feature flags, builtins.outputOf availability, and nix derivation show/add round-trips for penance and haskell.nix benchmark derivations.

phases.title: Commit-time lock generation
phases.notes: Runs penance-lock --check against the committed benchmark fixture lock and compares it with the real haskell.nix generated plan output.

phases.title: Static unit path on simple library fixture
phases.notes: The penance target is hpkgs.callCabal2nix, the nixpkgs generic Haskell builder, compared with the haskell.nix simple library build. Lock-driven unit builder iface/out cutoff behavior is tracked by M2-db-cutoff-matrix.

phases.title: Static unit path on module-heavy benchmark
phases.notes: The penance target is hpkgs.callCabal2nix, the nixpkgs generic Haskell builder, compared with the haskell.nix executable build. Lock-driven unit builder iface/out cutoff behavior is tracked by M2-db-cutoff-matrix.

phases.title: Module-granular path on Template Haskell benchmark
phases.notes: The penance target is one monolithic derivation that runs ghc -M, compiles each module with ghc -c, then links the executable. It does not emit per-module derivations or dynamic derivations; M4-dynamic-derivation-emission and M4-module-cutoff-30 track those mechanisms.

phases.title: First-class Backpack instantiation graph
phases.notes: Real Cabal Backpack fixture with one indefinite library, two implementation libraries, and two executable instantiations compared with the haskell.nix executable build.

phases.title: aarch64-linux target build
phases.notes: Builds C-language aarch64-linux ELF probes through the penance nixpkgs lane and the haskell.nix-overlay nixpkgs lane. A full Haskell cross build is tracked by M6-haskell-cross-aarch64.

phases.title: Multi-System Closure bundle
phases.notes: Creates closureInfo-backed bundle artifacts and manifests for the penance and haskell.nix benchmark executable closures.

phases.title: Device deploy and hot-swap loop
phases.notes: Writes each benchmark executable closure manifest into a device-cache directory and atomically exposes the managed service executable through a run-directory hot-swap symlink.
